provenance.purpose: Deterministic, network-free replay of the deployed Waltham Cross planner input used to validate the Alpha.15 PlannerServiceGroup abstraction.

runtimeBoundary.sourceComposition: cross-boundary NaPTAN + TfL StopPoint discovery; BODS + TNDS prepared national timetables; live TfL timetable checks

provenance.extractionMethod: Instantiated the deployed browser adapter chain against the run-19 Pages BODS/TNDS manifests and public TfL endpoints, captured the authoritative composed serviceResult.data after adapter normalization, StopPoint scoping, provider composition and identity merge, captured enriched selected stops at the planner call boundary, then retained only the declared public route-control scope. No route, operator, terminus, pattern or row was manually added.
provenance.confidentiality: Assessment origin removed. Only public StopPoint identities/coordinates, public prepared service evidence and calculated access distances are retained; no client identity, private address or private boundary is included.
